name: Cubing for Cancer RPV 2022

venue.name: [Rolling Hills Methodist Church](https://rhumc.org/#home)
venue.address: 26438 Crenshaw Blvd  Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274

information:
This competition is a series competition with [Circle City Supercharged 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CircleCitySupercharged2022). Registrants will only be accepted to one competition. If you register for both, we will accept whichever registration was completed first, unless otherwise noted.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BothellSpring2022#17574-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age.
